about: Mutants of compiler/cmd/nativeab, the stage receipt's attribution (NATIVE-AB-MEASURE, spec research/NATIVE-TOOLCHAIN). The laws over drawn builds (draw.ergo) and the origin law kill them; `nativeab verify --seed 17` runs the same checks over 200 seeds. Under CRUNCH (common.md, 2026-11-23) the ledger is named, not run: not-run-crunch.

mutants.name: phase-collapsed
mutants.rule: Each span is charged to its own stage: parse, check and unified work are never folded into one cell (not-run-crunch).

mutants.name: child-double-charge
mutants.to: cells[c] = got(cells, c) + p.Self + under(t, k)
mutants.rule: A tool's cell is its own Self: its children's instructions, counted in their own records, are not charged to it again (not-run-crunch).

mutants.name: foreign-attributed-to-ergo
mutants.from: } else if mod != "" && (pkg == mod || strings.HasPrefix(pkg, mod + "/")) {
mutants.rule: Only the generated module's packages are origin ergo; a Go package whose path starts with the module's name is foreign (not-run-crunch).

mutants.name: warm-fake-compile
mutants.rule: A cache hit ran no compile: a span recorded for it is refused, never charged (not-run-crunch).

mutants.name: missing-phase-zero
mutants.rule: A stage nobody measured has no cell: absent is not 0, so route B shows no parse or check cell rather than a zero one (not-run-crunch).

mutants.name: skip-failing-seed-minimization
mutants.rule: Remove extraneous build actions while preserving the planted route B disagreement; ordinary attribution laws never inspect the reduced case (not-run-crunch).
